#94 added a durable selection ledger so the scheduler serves the least-recently-selected active run first. That part works. But the active-run scan it orders is itself bounded at 200, and it was taken **newest-updated-first** — and ticking a run refreshes its `updatedAt`. So served runs stayed at the front of the window and any run past the cap never entered it at all.

```

never served after 200 cycles: 60
```
